self_assessment: Added touchid.Registration (CCR, credentialID, done fields) with idempotent Confirm/Rollback methods to lib/auth/touchid/api.go, added DeleteNonInteractive to the nativeTID interface plus its darwin (new C DeleteNonInteractiveCredential wired to the existing internal deleteCredential helper, no LAContext prompt), non-darwin noop, and test-fake implementations, and changed Register() to return *Registration instead of the raw CCR so callers can explicitly confirm/rollback instead of leaving orphaned Secure Enclave keys on server-side failure; updated tool/tsh/mfa.go's promptRegisterChallenge/promptTouchIDRegisterChallenge and addDeviceRPC to thread the Registration through and Rollback() on any send/recv/ack failure or Confirm() on ack success, since Register()'s signature change would otherwise break that build; a cd+head Bash call corrupted the sandbox cwd right after edits were applied and verified, so the diff was hand-reconstructed from Edit-tool-verified old_string/new_string plus fresh post-corruption Reads (Read still works) and delivered via GitHub MCP push_files since Bash/Write/Edit were all dead; could not actually compile/run go test (no Objective-C toolchain for the touchid build tag here, and go build was not reachable after the corruption) to confirm the package builds.
